config.world: Point clouds of N points in d dimensions read through observers C = diag(i^-alpha) R, R a Haar-random rotation, G = I, budget B = 0 for the law and a quantization sweep for the exploratory cell. Discovery on seven families at once (Gaussian at three covariance exponents, uniform cube, uniform ball, Student t with 5 degrees of freedom, a four-centre Gaussian mixture); held-out worlds of the same families at other shapes, dimensions and observer spectra; unseen families, real corpora and scale cells on the run seed only, against the law frozen at the pilot.
